description: Call BEFORE each model call, tool call or sub-agent spawn with your estimate. Returns allowed=true and deducts it, or allowed=false with the limit that tripped. When allowed is false, stop, do not retry, and return your partial result to the user. Atomic, so parallel sub-agents cannot both slip under the cap.

handle.description: The budget handle from open_budget (looks like bg_<id>.<secret>). Pass it to every sub-agent so they all spend from the same budget.

tokens.description: Estimated tokens of the next call.

usd.description: Estimated cost of the next call in USD.

name: reserve
